cohort: This study included 45 preterm infants born to mothers with COVID-19 at Dr. Soetomo General Academic Hospital, Surabaya, Indonesia, between May 2020 and April 2021.
finding: The study found that 13.3% of preterm infants born to mothers with COVID-19 developed NEC, and asphyxia and intubation of the mother before delivery were significantly associated with an increased risk of NEC, while a positive infant PCR result for COVID-19 alone was not a significant risk factor.
